svg.title: For product-test recovery take η ∈C∞ equal to one on supp v, and use Fourier surjectivity to c choose Schwartz f, g with bf+ = η and bg+ = v in the retained convention. Then bf+bg+ = v on all momentum space. Thus the actual tensor-test reader recovers every compact smooth momentum test without a density limit in the pair of fields. For fixed s > 0, insert vn = χne−sp0. On the trace side its limiting error is controlled by the finite positive damped mass; on each finite track it is controlled by the absolute damped product weight. Dominated convergence therefore recovers
